content: Unlike prior works BIBREF0 , BIBREF4 , our method does not attempt to align domain-specific words through pivot words. In our preliminary experiments, we found that word embeddings pre-trained on a large corpus are able to adequately capture this information. As we will later show in our experiments, even without adaptation, a naive neural network classifier with pre-trained word embeddings can already achieve reasonably good results.
